newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheong Ming offers 80 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.
newsitem.headline: Cheong Ming offers 80 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.

text.p: Printing concern Cheong Ming Holdings Ltd said on Monday it plans to offer 80 million shares at HK$1.00 per share in an initial public offer (IPO).
The issue price represents a prospective price to earnings ratio of 6.68 times on a fully diluted basis and 5.57 times on a weighted average basis, with a dividend yield of six percent.
Market capitalisation of Cheong Ming is HK$320 million.
The IPO runs from January 7-10, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on January 20. Lippo Securities Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
Of the net proceeds of about HK$70 million, Cheong Ming said HK$23.5 million will be used to buy a multi-colour paperboard printing machine and HK$15 million to buy a seven-colour printing machine.

Another HK$8 million will be used to fund construction of its printing factory in Dongguan in China's Guangdong province, HK$4 million to buy machinery for the factory, and the remaining HK$19.5 million for working capital.
Cheong Ming forecast earnings after tax but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$46 million for the year ending on March 31, 1997.
It reported net profit of HK$33.79 million for 1996 against HK$22.84 million in 1995 and HK$13.9 million in 1994.
Turnover rose to HK$233.75 million in 1996 from HK$158.62 million in 1995 and HK$121.66 million in 1994.
